records.reason: I do not accept this proposed positive-to-uncertain correction at present. Both of my source freezes interpret the explicitly measured 1.0 by 1.9 cm area of grade-4 chondrosis as severe/full-thickness report-level cartilage loss of qualifying extent. Root instead requires a named grading system or an independent literal depth statement. The frozen protocol contains no explicit named-system requirement, and the report calls the lesion grade-4 chondrosis rather than supplying a bare OA diagnosis. My positive interpretation uses clinical grading semantics, not an independent MRI measurement; that mapping remains disputed and is not certified here. Preserve this disagreement for further adjudication and do not include this item in the accepted runtime changes.
